text: A rainy Saturday at Grandma's house. She has asked you to help clear out the attic.

speaker: Grandma
text: Thank you for coming up, {name}. Watch your step. Some of these boxes are older than I am!

speaker: Grandma
text: That trunk by the window belonged to my grandfather. Would you open it for me? My knees and these stairs are not friends.

speaker: Grandma
text: The trunk by the window, dear.
Inside are an old Bible, worn soft at the edges, a folded letter, and a band of brass and glass.

speaker: Grandma
text: His Bible. He read it every morning of his life. And a letter! Let's see.

speaker: The letter
text: To whoever finds this: the band is a time device. It will take you to see the things written in this Book, as they happened.

speaker: The letter
text: You cannot change what happened. Watch, listen, and help where you can. When it is time to come home, find the glowing door.

speaker: Grandma
text: Well! He always did have an imagination.
The band snaps shut around your wrist. The glass lights up: LINKED TO {name}.

speaker: Grandma
text: Everything in that Book really happened. If you are going to see it, keep your eyes open, and come back and tell me all about it!
The attic spins. Rain, dust and lamplight swirl together, and then...
